findings.issue: The stated filling order incorrectly places 3d before 4s. The listed full-subshell occupancies are correct, but the Aufbau sequence must put 4s² before 3d¹⁰.
findings.evidence: The 1.5 answer_move explicitly gives “1s, 2s, 2p, 3s, 3p, 4s, 3d.” Correct the string to “1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁶ 4s² 3d¹⁰ 4p⁶ 5s² 4d¹⁰ 5p⁶ …”.

findings.issue: The core-electron row reverses shielding's effect. Holding other factors equal, more intervening core electrons weaken the attraction to valence electrons and lower ionization energy.
findings.evidence: The reference defines effective nuclear charge as the net positive charge experienced after shielding. Replace “Stronger | Higher” in the final row with “Weaker | Lower”.
